name: Deep Human (Human Variant)
body:
Humans are largely a surface-dwelling species, but in certain cases they are driven underground by disasters, war, or competition for resources. Over time, these humans became pale, thin, and brooding.

Underground, humans almost inevitably become more insular and obsessed with preserving and protecting whatever secret knowledge they possess. Many turn to occult powers to help them survive in the cold, lightless world of Subterranea.

Ability Score Modifiers You gain +2 Int, +2 Wis, –2 Con. This trait alters ability scores.
Languages You begin play speaking Common and Undercommon. If you have a high Intelligence score, you can choose from any of the following languages: Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, and Orc. This trait alters languages.
Heart of Darkness You gain darkvision to 60 feet, but you also have the light sensitivity trait. You gain a +2 species bonus on Knowledge (dungeoneering) checks, and a +4 species bonus on Stealth checks in underground terrain. This replaces skilled.

Awesome Ancestries: Variant Species Options, Vol. 2 – Mortals of the Multiverse. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum
